 Russell Martin hints at Leicester changes as four could miss Oxford City tie 
 Go to the comments section Add to your bookmarks Share this article Leicester City head to sixth-tier Oxford City in the FA Cup on Friday night, aiming to avoid a shock on an artificial surface. It is their first appearance at this stage in nearly 20 years.
 According to LeicesterMercury.co.uk, long-term absentees Jakub Stolarczyk and Ben Nelson remain out, while defender Jayden Joseph is sidelined for a few more weeks. Martin reported no new injuries and said a couple of players had illness earlier in the week but have trained and hopefully will be fine.
 OneFootball Videos
 He added that one or two might not be involved because of their injury records and the different surface, so some changes are possible. Even so, he is not planning wholesale rotation.
 For Oxford City, winger Ewan Clark is the only absentee and has yet to play this season. Manager Ross Jenkins said preparations have been thorough and he expects a sell-out, stressing the squad should enjoy the occasion despite the pressure.
 Oxford include former Leicester academy defender Darnell Johnson and ex-Watford forward Fernando Forestieri. Martin said Joseph is back in training and could return to the squad for the Huddersfield game.
 Source: LeicesterMercury.co.uk
